items.myth: IELTS ke bina admit nahi milta
items.fact: Requirement course pe depend karti hai
items.detail: Kai universities TOEFL, PTE ya Duolingo bhi maanti hain. Official site check karo.

items.myth: IELTS ek hi baar de sakte ho
items.detail: Kitni baar bhi de sakte ho. Pichhli galtiyon se seekh ke dobara do.

items.myth: Speaking mein accent judge hota hai
items.fact: Clarity aur fluency dekhi jaati hai
items.detail: Apne accent mein, saaf aur bina ruke bolo. Wahi kaafi hai.

youtube.title: IELTS ke bina admit nahi milta? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
English tests ke 3 myths. Requirement course pe depend karti hai (kai universities TOEFL, PTE ya Duolingo bhi maanti hain), IELTS retake kar sakte ho, aur speaking mein accent nahi, clarity aur fluency dekhi jaati hai. Free IELTS resources: app.goeduabroad.com/ielts-online-test-kit

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
